methodology: For each Grover-marked multi-axis actor, the committed actor_tenures.json lists federal role ranges sourced from the Canada Gazette, Parliament of Canada biographical records, and on-the-record news. Overlap days computed via standard interval intersection. Joint score = a.meta_amp * b.meta_amp * overlap_years — higher = more consequential concurrent cross-axis period. Per-actor concurrent_roles shows where one person held multiple federal portfolios simultaneously (cross-portfolio accountability surfaces).
